change.to: The third-party notebook, byte-for-byte, with ZERO code authored by us. Its environment block keeps OUR operating point (BIOHUB_MOTION_RELINK_TIGHT_UM = "5.5", identical to the value our own held-out PP-sweep selected as tight55) and adds: continuous gap-density adaptation (BIOHUB_GAP_DENSITY_ADAPTIVE=1, REFERENCE_UM=6.5, GAIN=0.040, MAX_STEP_DELTA_UM=0.125, NEIGHBORS=3); DivNet mitosis verification (BIOHUB_DIVNET_VERIFY=1, BIOHUB_DIV_MIN_PROB=0.50) from the public dataset giorgosi/biohub-divnet-v2; a mutual-best / relative-rank edge prior (_lb_mutual, _lb_rank_bonus added to raw) which is the SAME mechanism family as exp_062; and a safe-division mutual-nearest-neighbour gate (SAFE_DIV_REQUIRE_MUTUAL_NN). The expensive PP-sweep machinery is reduced (the selected value is frozen instead of re-swept), which is the likely source of the notebook's "19m" runtime claim.

review.summary: Genuine BLOCK. DivNet gate is structurally inoperative (6-D tensor into a Conv3d expecting 5-D, exception swallowed, veto gated on non-None) and the claim that the pipeline preserves our tight55 is false (discrete density overrides give 7.25/6.5/5.5 by measured density; 5.5 only on high-density movies). Both independently verified by Claude Code against the frozen snapshot. Also: ground_truth_accessed is a hardcoded constant not an observed record; pip runs in cell 7; the gate field is never emitted; expected_gpu_hours is not an enforceable ceiling.
